verdict.rationale: DeepInfra is an AI inference cloud, and whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions an open-source repository or license for DeepInfra's own code. Serving open models and offering SSH GPU clusters are adjacent features and do not count as access to the product's source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
